proposals.title: Advisory Vote on Modifying the Threshold to Call Special Shareholders' Meetings
proposals.topic_summary: Requests board take steps to let holders of 10% of outstanding common stock call a special shareholder meeting, lowering the current 25% threshold.
proposals.evidence: Our Board recommends that you vote "AGAINST" this proposal.

proposals.title: Advisory Vote on Report on Reducing Plastics Use
proposals.proponent: As You Sow Foundation, on behalf of The Leventhal-Walton Family Trust dated May 8, 2015 as amended, and two co-filers
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a board report describing how McDonald's will reduce plastics use in alignment with the Pew Report to feasibly reduce ocean pollution.
proposals.evidence: Our Board recommends that you vote "AGAINST" this proposal.

proposals.title: Advisory Vote on Report on Antibiotics and Public Health Costs
proposals.proponent: The Shareholder Commons, representing Trinity College, Cambridge
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on public-health costs of antibiotic use in the supply chain and how such costs may affect shareholder market returns.
proposals.evidence: Our Board recommends that you vote "AGAINST" this proposal.

proposals.title: Advisory Vote on Disclosure Regarding Confinement in the Company's U.S. Pork Supply Chain
proposals.proponent: The Humane Society of the United States
proposals.topic_summary: Requests confirmation that gestating pig confinement in stalls will end in the U.S. pork supply chain by 2022, or disclosure of related percentages and risks.
proposals.evidence: Our Board recommends that you vote "AGAINST" the advisory proposal requesting additional disclosure regarding the use of confinement stalls

proposals.title: Advisory Vote on Third-Party Civil Rights Audit
proposals.topic_summary: Requests board oversight of a third-party audit of McDonald's policies' adverse impact on civil rights of company stakeholders, with a public report.
proposals.evidence: Our Board recommends that you vote "AGAINST" this proposal.

proposals.title: Advisory Vote on Report on Lobbying Activities and Expenditures
proposals.topic_summary: Requests annual board report disclosing direct and indirect lobbying, grassroots communications, payments and decision-making oversight.
proposals.evidence: Our Board recommends that you vote "AGAINST" this proposal.

proposals.title: Advisory Vote on Report on Global Public Policy and Political Influence
proposals.topic_summary: Requests annual transparency report on global public policy and political influence expenditures outside the U.S., including recipients, amounts and memberships.
proposals.evidence: Our Board recommends that you vote "AGAINST" this proposal.
